Upload a handwritten answer sheet → AI-assisted OCR → rubric grading → AI feedback → voice-enabled chatbot.

Built with **Next.js · TypeScript · Tailwind · Prisma + SQLite**. Powered by **Groq** (free tier) with **Gemini** as failsafe and **Hugging Face** embeddings.

**Features**

- **Vision OCR** (Groq → Gemini fallback) on handwritten sheets
- **Hybrid rubric scoring** — 0.6 × semantic similarity + 0.4 × keyword match (Porter-stemmer tolerant)
- **AI feedback** per question, regeneratable with one click
- **Voice chatbot** — Web Speech API with Groq Whisper fallback
- **Rubric manager** — JSON rubrics under `/rubrics/`, easy to git-track
- **Grading history** — every submission persists via Prisma
